messages.subject: Vholes settlement — our mark-up
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Our redline attached. Key changes: non-compete reduced to 9 months (we'd have preferred removal but accept 9 as a compromise), ex gratia increased to £110,000, and the legal fees contribution to £2,500 plus VAT. Client and employee non-solicit left at 12 months as you required.

Amelia Hart
Associate
Castle & Vane LLP

Lorna — this lands almost exactly where the Board authorised: 9-month non-compete, non-solicit covenants intact. They've pushed the ex gratia to £110k and fees to £2,500+VAT. I'd recommend accepting — it's within authority and gives us an enforceable covenant. Total cost moves to roughly £268k gross. OK to confirm?

Sarah
